name: Mashed Peas on Toast with Fried Egg & Bacon
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat; add bacon and cook until crisp, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallots and garlic.
When the bacon is done, remove and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate. Transfer the bacon fat to a small bowl and set aside, leaving about 2 tbsp of fat in the skillet.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat; add shallots and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add peas, water, and goat cheese to the skillet with the shallots; cook, stirring occasionally, until almost no liquid remains, about 5 minutes.
Roughly chop the bacon and return to the plate.
Wash and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Add pea mixture to the bowl with the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper; mash until almost smooth.
Wipe out skillet and put back on stove over medium heat.
Add 2 tbsp of reserved bacon fat to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom; gently crack eggs into skillet and cook until whites are set but yolks are still runny, about 3 minutes.
To serve, spread mashed peas over toast, top with bacon, egg, salt, and pepper. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
